'''Spacia trees''' were native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Achillea]]. They were huge [[Tree/Legends|trees]] that grew in plantations across the world's southern land mass. Spacia timber was shipped to off-planet markets to be used for fine furniture manufacturing.<ref name="LE" />
